query.text: 请帮我们检查舞蹈动作，有不规范的地方及时纠正，练习结束后简要总结动作表现。
query.text_en: Please check our dance moves, correct anything irregular right away, and briefly summarize the performance when practice ends.

annotation.text_zh: 下蹲时膝盖再弯曲一点，身体自然前倾。
annotation.text_en: Bend your knees a bit more as you squat, and lean forward naturally.

annotation.text_zh: 右手向上完全伸直，身体向左侧弯。
annotation.text_en: Stretch your right arm straight up and bend your body to the left.

annotation.text_zh: 这里要深蹲下去，上身前倾，保持平衡。
annotation.text_en: Squat down here, lean forward, and keep your balance.

annotation.text_zh: 右手向上指，身体向上延伸，姿态要舒展。
annotation.text_en: Point your right hand up, stretch your body upward, and keep your posture open.

annotation.text_zh: 整体节奏跟得很好，注意下蹲和延伸的幅度。
annotation.text_en: Your rhythm is great, just watch the depth of your squats and extensions.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
